- Initial release of zillow-fpx for querying zillow.com via the fpx CLI, as an alternative to the zillow-mcp server.
- Fetch Zillow data—including listings, property records by zpid, price/tax/Zestimate history, photos, market reports, and saved searches/homes—using one-shot HTTP calls routed through a signed-in browser tab.
- No credentials are stored; requires the fetchproxy browser extension and a signed-in zillow.com tab.
- All data is scraped from server-rendered HTML pages; there is no direct JSON API.
- Offers clear instructions for setup, usage, and handling authentication/browser wall issues.
